datasets.name: ProlongsData
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, prolongdate, newclosedate, oldclosedate, newtrance, newoblication
  FROM cm_prolongations
WHERE CreditID=:CreditID
Order By ProlongDate Desc

datasets.name: CreditInfo
datasets.sql:
select BOOROWERID,credittype,
  NVL(DUEDATELASTCONTRACT,DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT) as DUEDATE
from
  CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS
where ID =:ID

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
update cm_curr_state set  OBLIGATION =:OBLIGATION
where creditid=:creditid

datasets.name: TrancheAccounts
datasets.sql:
SELECT   id AS accid, kli_id, acc_no AS accountnumber, NAME AS accountname
    FROM account
   WHERE (    kli_id = :kli_id
          AND bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                            FROM cm_aginfo
                           WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                              FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                             WHERE g.iname = 'ClientAccs'))
         )
UNION ALL
SELECT   id AS accid, kli_id, acc_no AS accountnumber, NAME AS accountname
    FROM account
   WHERE ((bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                         FROM cm_aginfo
                        WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                           FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                          WHERE g.iname = 'InternalBankAccs'))
          )
         )
ORDER BY kli_id, accountnumber

datasets.name: CustAccount
datasets.sql:
select 
      BOOROWERACCID 
   from 
      CM_ACCOUNTS
 where CreditID=:CreditID
